definitions.ask: Which keep window should replace the count-of-10 archive gate?
definitions.why: Quiet notes stay current for a week and busy notes stay small

choices.label: Keep the newest 10 closures from the last 7 days; busy notes keep about a day
Archive everything closed before this ISO week; the visible window swings 0-6 days
Keep 7 days with no cap; bob.md and sase.md keep about 65 closed rows each

definitions.ask: Should finished projects stay frozen as their own records?
definitions.why: A finished project note is already its own record, and ^prj links stay live

choices.label: Their 243 closed rows stay in place for good; reopening a project needs no restore
Their non-^prj closed rows archive like any active project's

definitions.ask: When a source note is renamed, should its archive file be renamed to match?
definitions.why: About 30 code paths still assume the filename rule

choices.label: Rename the archive to the canonical name and repair inbound done/ links in the same run
Keep the old archive name; readers follow done_tasks:/parent: metadata instead

definitions.ask: Should reopening an archived task from a plugin restore it to its source note?
definitions.why: One gesture still works, and no open task is ever left inside done/

choices.label: The plugin runs bob task restore --reopen and the task returns open to its source
The plugin refuses the in-place reopen and shows a Notice naming bob task restore
